steps.name: AIO-42231/42232 | Step 1-2: Launch Hana-POS and log in → Expected: Hana Dashboard is displayed
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to HANA Florist POS', level: 3 })
AIO-42233 | Step 3: Navigate to Customers → Expected: Customer page with the customer grid
AIO-42234 | Step 4: Using New Customer, create a disposable test customer with no history → Expected: The disposable customer is created and appears in the grid
AIO-42235 | Step 5: Click the action (three-line) icon on the disposable customer's row → Expected: The row action menu opens listing the Delete option
Click locator('#gvCustomers tbody tr:has-text("DelCleanWintheiser") td.hana-action-column a.dropdown-toggle').first()
AIO-42236 | Step 6: Click Delete and click "Yes, delete it!" → Expected: The toast "Customer deleted succesfully" is displayed and the customer is removed without error
A delete success toast containing "deleted" should appear after confirming the delete
